entries.prompt:
Assign exactly one category to each transaction.
Allowed categories:
- Food: groceries, supermarkets, warehouse clubs, restaurants, coffee, food delivery
- Transportation: fuel, rideshare, taxis, transit, parking
- Shopping: general retail, online marketplaces, clothing, electronics
- Entertainment: streaming, music, apps, games, movies
- Healthcare: pharmacy, doctors, medical, gym and fitness
- Home: hardware stores, home improvement, furnishings
- Housing: rent or mortgage payments
- Insurance: auto, home, health or life insurance premiums
- Utilities: internet, cable, electricity, water, phone
- Cash: ATM withdrawals
- Other: cannot be determined from the text

A credit from a merchant is a refund: use that merchant's category.
Use Other if you cannot tell. Never invent a category.
Reply with ONLY a JSON object mapping every id to a category name, e.g. {"t001": "Food"}.

provenance: HAND-AUTHORED FIXTURE, NOT A CAPTURE OF A REAL MODEL RUN. No LLM provider was reachable when this project was assembled (no Ollama daemon, no API key). Replies were written to imitate a small local model and recorded through the real RecordingClient by scripts/make_recording.py. The record/replay machinery is real; the reply text is not model output. The first controller reply is deliberately unparseable so that plain replay exercises the recovery path.
